CHAPTER.VERS: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, That walks in his ways.
For you will eat the labor of your hands: Happy you will be, and it will be well with you.
Your wife will be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of your house; Your sons like olive plants, Around your table.
Look, thus will the [able-bodied] man be blessed That fears Yahweh.
Yahweh will bless you out of Zion: And you will see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
Yes, you will see the sons of your sons. Peace be on Israel.
